originalTitle: "Turn Around, It's a Trap!" — Homeless Girl Saved 28 Bikers, What They Did Next Left Her in Tears
content: She had no phone, no address and no ID. All she had was a notebook full of license plates—and the nerve to stand in front of 28 motorcycles. Josie Avery aged out of foster care with a garbage bag and a bus ticket. For fourteen months she has lived in a trailer under the Old Ferry Bridge. One Sunday morning she runs out of the pines and stands in the middle of the road as a whole motorcycle club rides down the hill to honor Eli, killed in a hit-and-run eight months ago. "Stop! Turn around—it's a trap!" The curve is greased with oil, the railing has no bolts, a man with a rifle waits across the river, and someone sits in a boat under the bridge so nobody makes it out of the water. The club's leader, Pop, is the only witness at tomorrow's trial. The bikers catch the road crew red-handed. Then a county deputy rolls down the hill, calls the bikers an armed gang, and looks the homeless girl up and down: no address, no ID, oil on her shoes. He opens the back door of his patrol car. She rides with him and they all go home—or everybody goes to jail, and Pop misses court. 👉 Watch till the end — the girl nobody ever bothered to ask is about to show a whole town what she wrote down. If you love stories where the person everyone overlooks turns out to be the only one who was paying attention, subscribe for a new story every week. This is a fictional story made for entertainment. All characters, places and events are invented. #BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story
chineseContent: 她没有电话，没有地址，也没有身份证。她所拥有的只是一本写满车牌的笔记本，以及站在 28 辆摩托车面前的勇气。乔西·艾弗里 (Josie Avery) 带着垃圾袋和公交车票离开了寄养家庭。十四个月以来，她一直住在旧渡轮桥下的一辆拖车里。一个周日的早晨，她跑出松树，站在路中间，整个摩托车俱乐部骑着马下山，纪念八个月前在一场肇事逃逸事件中丧生的伊莱。 “停下！转身——这是一个陷阱！”弯道上涂满了油，栏杆没有螺栓，一个拿着步枪的人在河对岸等待，有人坐在桥下的船上，所以没有人从水里出来。俱乐部领导人波普是明天审判的唯一证人。骑自行车的人当场抓住了公路工作人员。然后，一名县副官从山上滚下来，称骑自行车的人是武装团伙，并上下打量了这个无家可归的女孩：没有地址，没有身份证，鞋子上沾满了油。他打开巡逻车的后门。她和他一起骑车，然后他们都回家了——或者每个人都进了监狱，而爸爸缺席了法庭。 👉 看到最后——那个没人费心去问的女孩即将向全镇的人展示她写下的内容。如果你喜欢那些被所有人忽视的人其实是唯一在关注的人的故事，那么每周订阅一个新故事。这是一个虚构的故事，仅供娱乐。所有人物、地点和事件都是虚构的。 #BikerStory #HomelessGirl #Story
